name: hpclaw-dsh-plugin
description: Expose HPClaw capabilities as DeepSeek Harness agent tools: cluster run_command bridge with user confirmation, cluster_fs file access and local<->cluster transfer, zero-dependency CDP browser control (browser_open/eval/click/type/screenshot/close), WheatOmics/GitHub-mirror CLI wrappers, read-only HPClaw local API bridge, an HPClaw command-safety pre-execute gate for dsh's bash/pwsh tools, and an HPClaw domain system-prompt section.
